verdict.rationale: cubic is mainly a code-review product, but it documents its own fix capability: it generates fixes for review findings, pushes commits to the PR branch, and can be asked in PR comments to fix issues. That only partly matches the story's bug-fixing half. missing for 10: implementing new features from a plain-language description, evidence that fixes span multiple files, free-form bug requests not tied to a review finding, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
By default, cubic pushes commits directly to your PR branch.
